description: This file defines a Spring configuration class that registers a global filter for the API Gateway. The filter extracts the user principal, adds a specific header to the request, and manages request flow within the gateway.

classes.name: GatewayConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class that defines a global filter bean for the Spring Cloud Gateway, responsible for injecting user identity headers into requests.

methods.name: customGlobalFilter
methods.description: Defines a global filter that retrieves the user principal and appends an authentication header to each request, ensuring user identification propagates through proxy requests.
